name: The Division 2
description: Plan a level-40 PvE build for The Division 2. Configure gear, weapons, skills, specialization, SHD Watch and item Expertise to preview armor, health, weapon damage, DPS, skill damage and recovery estimates. Modeled permanent bonuses apply automatically; use Assumptions for conditional effects. Assumptions are view settings and are not saved or shared. Estimates use community references and need live-game verification. Some talents and skill outputs remain unmodeled; combat events, ammunition, Overcharge and PvP normalization are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Activity
numericContextInputs.description: Where the build is played. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone normalize Prototype items: their attributes count at the bottom of the Prototype range and augments are disabled. The Blackout Dark Zone's PvP augment values are not modeled.

options.label: Raid, Incursion or Toxic Dark Zone

numericContextInputs.name: Target Out of Cover
numericContextInputs.description: Whether the selected enemy is out of cover, so Damage to Targets Out of Cover applies to weapon damage in the target estimates. Off by default.

numericContextInputs.name: Practical Hit Rate (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Share of shots that hit, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 70%; an editable reference, not a measured accuracy.

numericContextInputs.name: Headshots among Hits (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Share of the hits that land on the head, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 25%.

numericContextInputs.name: Charging Retained Eligible Seconds
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit retained qualifying charge progress, expressed as whole eligible seconds (0–14), not wall-clock time. Assumes those seconds qualified in combat and out of cover; caps protection at 50%, or 70% with selected Overcharging. Safe Charging changes gain from 5% to 10% per second. Zero asserts no retained protection. Does not infer combat, cover, Charged sharing, movement immunity, pauses, consumption, uptime or actual incoming hits.

numericContextInputs.name: Stoic Enemies Targeting You
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit qualifying enemies targeting you (0–8). No targeting is inferred. The combined player/Decoy count is limited to eight as a conservative planner bound; the current live cap needs verification. Four effective Aegis pieces required. Does not simulate incoming hits or protection stacking.

numericContextInputs.name: Stoic Additional Decoy Targets
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit additional enemies targeting your eligible Decoy, not already counted as targeting you (0–8). Requires equipped selected Deceit and four effective Aegis pieces. Combined targets are limited to eight as a planner bound. Does not infer an active Decoy, targets or group state.

numericContextInputs.name: Stoic Group Agents Including You
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed ordinary PvE group size including you (1–4); interprets the pinned 1.X rule as 1.1 for one agent through 1.4 for four. Solo counting and live resistance stacking need verification. No matchmaking, raid grouping, teammates or mitigation is inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Headache Current Armor Pool
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit current armor value used as the source pool for Headache's available full-armor bonus-armor ceiling: 50%, or 100% with equipped selected Stand Tall. Zero means no supplied pool. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. Does not substitute estimated maximum armor, infer full armor, eligible MMR headshots or cycle state, or grant bonus armor. This capacity is independent of the available repair budget and is not an executed conversion.

numericContextInputs.name: Umbra Shadow Stacks to Consume
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit Shadow stacks to consume in one continuous-cover repair estimate (0–100), capped at 50 or 100 with equipped selected Into the Light. Zero means no consumption asserted. Uses unadjusted 0.8% estimated maximum armor per stack and 10 stacks/s; delivery time is a continuous budget estimate, not a tick schedule. Does not infer retained stacks, actual consumption, cover eligibility, missing armor, repair scaling, regeneration or overlaps. Independent of the separate Light damage assumption.

numericContextInputs.name: Return to Sender Eligible Skill Damage
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit eligible damage actually dealt by your skills for one unadjusted PvE repair budget. Base self/ally shares are 10%/20%, or pinned catalog 25%/35% with selected Increased Interest. Zero asserts no event. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. Does not infer hits from skill previews, mitigation, recipients, missing armor, repair scaling, overlaps or bonus-armor conversion.

numericContextInputs.name: Ground Control Eligible Ally Repair
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit eligible repair amount delivered to an ally for one Ground Control proximity budget. The unadjusted share is 60%, or 120% with selected Advanced Combat Tactics, for each eligible recipient. Zero asserts no event. The 0–10,000,000 bound is a planner limit. No distance, recipient count, missing armor, repair scaling or recursive feedback is inferred. Independent of the full-armor damage bonus.

numericContextInputs.name: Makeshift Qualifying Damage
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit eligible damage received by the agent or shield for a Makeshift Repairs budget estimate. The unadjusted source budget goes to each recipient, not split between them. Zero means no damage asserted. The 0–10,000,000 range is a planner bound, not a game cap. No hit, damage mitigation, missing armor, Repair Skills scaling, overlaps or actual recovery are inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Hackstep Qualifying Bonus Armor (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Explicit bonus armor gained that currently qualifies for Hackstep Protocol's damage bonus, in percentage points of armor (0–100). The estimate uses 2% Total Weapon Damage per complete 5%, capped at 20%. Zero means inactive. No bonus armor, ability use, source eligibility, consumption, duration or damage events are inferred; the passive available grant does not fill this input.

numericContextInputs.name: Clutch Missing Armor (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed missing fraction of estimated maximum armor, in percentage points (0–100), for one eligible Clutch critical hit. Zero means full armor. clutch_repair_state separately asserts eligibility, including its armor threshold or current post-kill window; this input does not activate the talent. No damage or repair sequence is simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Rebalance Red Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Harrier Pride Red stacks (0–79), each adding 0.5% Weapon Damage. Red and Blue stacks together stay below the 80-stack cap; the post-cap separate bonus, stack generation, and resets are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Rebalance Blue Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Harrier Pride Blue stacks (0–79), each adding 0.5% Damage Resistance. Red and Blue stacks together stay below the 80-stack cap; the post-cap separate bonus, stack generation, and resets are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Blossom Harvest Target Armor+Health %
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed combined armor and health the current target has remaining (0–100%, in steps of 10). First Bloom amplifies weapon damage by 3.3% per full 10%. Zero means no amplification; target health is not tracked.

numericContextInputs.name: Bleeding Edge Bleeding Enemies
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed bleeding enemies within 15m (0–5) with Bleeding Edge (G403): 1 to 5 repair 3%, 6%, 12%, 24% or 48% of your armor per second, as Armor Regeneration. Bleed application and duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Bob and Weave Meters Run
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed meters run in one cover-to-cover move with Bob and Weave (0–20), each repairing 5% of your total armor (G403). The 20 is a planner bound; healing of damage taken during the move is not modeled.

numericContextInputs.name: Hoarder Extra Enemies in the Blast
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed extra enemies caught in a grenade blast beyond the first (0–10), each adding 25% Grenade Damage with Hoarder (G402). The 10 is a planner bound.

numericContextInputs.name: Busy Little Bee Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed Busy Little Bee stacks carried into the swap (0–10), each amplifying weapon damage by 20% for 10 seconds after swapping away from the weapon (G401). Applies while another weapon is active. Stack generation from shots at different targets and the duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Alternating Current Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Alternating Current stacks (0–10), each adding 2.5% Skill Damage (G398). The game puts the stacks on one skill at a time and moves them to the other after 10 seconds at the cap; the planner applies them to both skills' estimates. Stack generation and transfer are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Shakedown Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Shakedown stacks on the target (0–4). shakedown_shot selects the body-shot amplification (4% per stack) or the consuming headshot (11% per stack). Stack generation, target switching, and the weakpoint bonus are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Bloodsucker Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current retained Bloodsucker stacks (0–10). Kill generation, refresh, and 10-second duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Adrenaline Rush Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Adrenaline Rush stacks (0–3). adrenaline_rush_active=true separately asserts a valid current 5-second bonus from a qualifying within-10m trigger; current distance is not inferred. Triggering, cooldown, and duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Chemical Agent Catalysis Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Chemical Agent Catalysis stacks (0–12), each adding 2% Weapon Damage and 2% Status Effects. The Reactant bonus-armor branch uses reactant_active to assert the valid 5-second bonus after an enemy that was status affected is killed at max Catalysis; once asserted, it does not require the current stack input to remain at 12 or the current target to remain status affected. Stack generation, decay, timers, and kill events are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Capacitance Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Capacitance stacks (0–40), each adding 1.5% Skill Damage. Shooting, stack generation, and decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Sawyer's Kneepads Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Stand Your Ground stacks (0–10). sawyer_active asserts the valid buff, including stacks retained after moving and before their 10-second expiry. Movement, stack generation, and expiry are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Memento Trophy Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current long-term Memento trophies (0–30); each contributes 1% Weapon Damage, 1% Skill Efficiency, and 0.1% Armor Regeneration. The separate short-buff assumption uses automatically counted configured cores. Trophy collection and timers are excluded.

numericContextInputs.name: Liberty Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Liberty weapon-damage stacks (0–30), adding 2% Weapon Damage each. Hit generation, headshot consumption, and shield repair are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Incessant Chatter Magazine Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed retained valid Incessant Chatter magazine-buff stacks (0–5), adding 25% Rate of Fire each. This is not the current enemy count; reload eligibility, kills, refill, and magazine duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Obliterate Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current stack count. Perfect Obliterate caps at 24; ordinary Obliterate caps at 20. Critical-hit stack generation and the 10s timer are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Unstoppable Force Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current stack count (0-5). Kill cadence, the 15s timer, and grenade kills adding 2 stacks are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Strained Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current firing stack count. Perfect Strained caps at 8; ordinary Strained caps at 5. Firing time and stack generation are not simulated. Only critical hit damage is added; critical damage is not applied to the weapon preview.

numericContextInputs.name: Magazine Ammo Missing (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed missing percentage of the selected weapon's magazine. Optimist scales continuously and linearly from the source wording; 100% is a theoretical empty-magazine boundary, not a firing state or ammo simulation.

numericContextInputs.name: Fast Hands Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current stack count (0-40). Critical-hit stack generation is not simulated. The reload-speed bonus feeds estimated reload time and conventional reload-cycle DPS, with stacks held fixed throughout the reference cycle.

numericContextInputs.name: Breadbasket Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current bonus stacks for the next headshot (0-3; Perfect Breadbasket caps at 2). Body-shot stack generation, next-headshot consumption, and the 10s timer are not simulated. This adds only the Headshot Damage stat bonus; it is not applied to the regular weapon-card preview.

numericContextInputs.name: Rifleman Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current headshot-generated stack count (0-6; ordinary Rifleman caps at 5). Headshot generation, duration refresh, and the 5s timer are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Future Perfect Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current kill stacks (0-4; ordinary Future Perfect caps at 3). Kill generation and the 15/19-second timers are not simulated. Skill Tier remains an uncapped bonus total; selected skill previews clamp effective tier to 0-6. Overcharge is not modeled.

numericContextInputs.name: Steady Handed Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current pre-consumption stack count (0-99). Valid snapshots are 0-99 for Steady Handed and 0-74 for Perfect Steady Handed; stacks at either talent's refill threshold are consumed. At or above the perfect threshold, its Accuracy and Stability bonus is withheld. Hit generation, consumption events, and magazine refills are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Kinetic Momentum Skill 1 Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current in-combat stacks for Skill 1 while it is active or not on cooldown (0-18). Each stack adds 1.5% Total Skill Damage and 2% Total Skill Repair. Ordinary Kinetic Momentum caps at 15; Perfect caps at 18. Stack generation, selected-skill inference, cooldowns, and timers are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Kinetic Momentum Skill 2 Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current in-combat stacks for Skill 2 while it is active or not on cooldown (0-18). Each stack adds 1.5% Total Skill Damage and 2% Total Skill Repair. Ordinary Kinetic Momentum caps at 15; Perfect caps at 18. Stack generation, selected-skill inference, cooldowns, and timers are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Focus Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current qualifying 8x-or-higher scoped aiming stacks (0-10) for Focus or Perfect Focus. The bonus caps at ten stacks (50% or 60%). Aiming time, scope state, target selection, and buff timing are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Overwhelm Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-4) for Overwhelm or Perfect Overwhelm. Suppression eligibility, stack generation, 12-second timers, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Pumped Up Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-25) for Pumped Up or Perfect Pumped Up; the ordinary talent caps at 25 and Perfect caps at 5. Reload stack generation, 10-second timers, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Stabilize Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current retained stacks (0-75) for Stabilize or Perfect Stabilize; ordinary caps at 60 and Perfect at 75. Firing generation, reset after 4/6 seconds, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Striker's Gamble Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Striker's Gamble stacks (0-200). The cap is 100 without the Press the Advantage host equipped and talent selected, or 200 with it. Weapon-hit stack generation and stack decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Throttle Control Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Throttle Control stacks (0-75). The cap is 50 without the Sustainability host equipped and talent selected, or 75 with it. Shooting, stack decay, and suppression are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Heartbreaker Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Heartstopper stacks (0-100); the cap is 50 without the Max BPM chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Each stack adds 1% Bonus Armor, or 2% with the Cold backpack host equipped and selected; self Bonus Armor does not require target_pulsed=true. Headshot pulse application, hit generation, and stack decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Camaraderie Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Concentrated Company stacks (0-35). Ally/skill contribution and stack generation/decay are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Negotiator's Dilemma Critical Hit Damage Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Hostile Negotiations stacks (0-10), each adding 10% Critical Hit Damage. Marking, damage transfer, and combat-end reset are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Umbra Into the Light Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Into the Light stacks (0-100); the cap is 50 without the From the Shadows chest host equipped and selected, or 100 with it. Buff eligibility is asserted separately; stack gain, consumption, decay, and Armor Regeneration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Huddle Qualifying Allies
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed number of ally Agents currently in the qualifying Hive or Smart Cover range (0-7 planner input bound; the source does not define a maximum). Each ally adds one Skill Tier. Existing skill previews clamp effective Skill Tier to 0-6.

numericContextInputs.name: On Point Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current On Point stacks before the reload that activated the buff (0-200 planner input bound). The formula caps effective stacks at the equipped weapon magazine estimate; the source defines the cap as the selected Rifle or Marksman Rifle Magazine Size. Stack generation and reload timing are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Ranger Target Distance (m)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed distance to the target (0-100m planner bound). Ranger bonuses count completed 4m intervals and Perfect Ranger bonuses count completed 3m intervals; partial intervals do not add damage. The 100m bound is a planner input limit, not a claimed in-game maximum. Ranger's exact interval rounding and live behavior still need in-game validation.

numericContextInputs.name: Brazen Previous-Shot Pellets
numericContextInputs.description: Manually supplied number of pellets that hit on the prior eligible shotgun shot (0–100 planner bound, not a claimed shotgun pellet maximum). brazen_next_shot_active asserts the next-shot bonus is currently eligible; shot events and pellet hits are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Intimidate Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Intimidate stacks (0–10); ordinary Intimidate caps at 9 and Perfect Intimidate at 10. intimidate_active asserts valid bonus armor and a target within 10m. Bonus-armor generation, stack timing, loss, and target distance are not inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Precision Strike Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Precision Strike stacks (0–3); ordinary Precision Strike caps at 3 and Perfect Precision Strike caps at 2. precision_strike_active asserts the qualifying close-target hit and 5-second bonus window. Kill distance, target distance, stack generation, consumption, and timing are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Prima Donna Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current You can look...but you can't touch stacks (0–10); each adds 11% amplified weapon damage. Out-of-combat eligibility, damage-triggered stack consumption, replenishment timing, and repairs are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Unnerve Target Marks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Unnerve marks on this target (0–5), each adding 15% amplified Weapon Damage. Kill and proximity conditions, mark application, and the 10-second timer are not inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Full Stop Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Full Stop stacks (0–20), each adding 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. Hit and headshot stack generation, reload clearing, temporary armor, magazine refills, and Dread Edict's no-reload headshot-kill effect are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Payment in Kind Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Payment in Kind stacks (0–100), each adding 2% Critical Hit Damage. Damage stack generation, the 10-second lifetime, reload-triggered bleed, and armor damage are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Big Game Hunter Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Big Game Hunter stacks (0–25), each adding 6% Headshot Damage. The scoped 450% shot branch, headshot stack generation, decay, and timing are not modeled.

numericContextInputs.name: Cover Shooter Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Cover Shooter stacks (0–100), each adding 1% Weapon Damage. In-cover shot generation, kill refresh, the 15-second duration, and reset/cancel conditions are not inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Gangland Hit Other-Agent Marks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained marks from other agents on the marked target (0–3), each adding 5% Weapon Damage amplification above Gangland Hit's own 20% marked-target bonus. gangland_hit_active asserts your own mark is on the current target. Mark application, transfer, other-agent actions, and mark duration are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Pakhan Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed current Pakhan magazine-bonus stacks for the next magazine (0–4), each adding 75% Base Magazine Size as a raw Magazine Size bonus total. Kill generation, next-magazine timing, and actual magazine capacity are not calculated.

numericContextInputs.name: Eagle's Strike Accuracy Bonus (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Manually supplied current Eagle's Strike Accuracy bonus (0–30 percentage points), capped at the source-described 30%. Continuous firing, accuracy buildup/decay, and Tenacity are not modeled.

numericContextInputs.name: Vicious Cycle Stacks
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed currently retained Vicious Cycle stacks (0–30), each adding 1.5% Weapon Damage. Stack generation, the full-stack purge, status-effect removal, and the healing cloud/ally repairs are not simulated.

numericContextInputs.name: Decoy King Amplification (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Manually supplied current Decoy King weapon-amplification value (0–25 percentage points, in 5-point steps); 0 means inactive. Moon-phase progression, timing, combat eligibility, Decoy Overcharge, and the paused cycle are not inferred.

numericContextInputs.name: Restorer Duration Source Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows the Restorer source duration estimate before Nanite. The source equation adds this variant's installed Expertise bonus and, when selected, its local Polycarbonate Housing duration mod in one percentage pool, then applies all-skills Skill Duration with Skill Efficiency counted once; the source flat-seconds term is assumed zero. Nanite is intentionally excluded, and this comparison does not replace ordinary duration or establish live runtime behavior. Its nonnegative guard follows the planner's formula convention and is not source proof. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Damage Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge damage for selected damaging skills. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary previews. Utility, healing, cooldowns, timers, proc eligibility and DPS are excluded. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Healing Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge healing for selected healing skills. Does not activate Overcharge or alter ordinary previews. Source measurement units are retained; recipient caps, Incoming Repairs, application events, utility, duration and timers are excluded. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Geometry Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge radius, range and cone-angle references for selected reviewed variants. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary outputs. Source geometry only; no area, detection, targets hit, recipients or amplification. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Capacity Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge maximum charges, ammo, deployables, zones or targets for selected reviewed variants. Maximum counts only; no remaining charges, refill time, self-revive consumption, targets hit or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Lifetime Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge deployment, cloud or effect-lifetime references for selected reviewed variants. Source lifetime only; no time remaining, status duration, recipient buff duration, uptime or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Status Duration Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical unresisted Overcharge status-duration references for selected reviewed variants. Separate from deployment lifetime; no application, recipient resistance, immunity, ticks, remaining timers or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Health Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge device, shield, zone or foam health capacity for selected reviewed variants. No current health, survival, damage taken or shield invulnerability. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Utility Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge speed, threat, support properties, shield regeneration, raw Hive haste and Reviver armor bonuses for selected reviewed variants. No combined Hive refill or restored armor, applied recipient buffs, refreshed timers, travel time or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Overcharge Recovery Comparison
numericContextInputs.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge ordinary cooldown or single-ammo recovery estimates for selected reviewed variants. No Hive refill, charge speed, current timer, full refill, actual readiness or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

numericContextInputs.name: Assault Turret Shots per Burst
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed landed shots per burst. Starts at the recorded 20-shot reference; timing stays editable.

numericContextInputs.name: Assault Turret Firing Time (s)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed seconds spent firing one burst. Starts at the approximately 5-second recorded reference.

numericContextInputs.name: Assault Turret Burst Pause (s)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed pause between bursts, including reload. The 1-second starting value is the recorded upper-bound reference; deployment and redeployment are excluded.

numericContextInputs.name: Assumed Tick Interval (s)
numericContextInputs.description: Seconds between damage ticks. Starts at 0.5 seconds. Shared by burn, bleed and Oxidizer previews; does not model duration, refresh or overlapping applications.

numericContextInputs.name: Stinger Repeat Interval (s)
numericContextInputs.description: Assumed seconds between landed stings on one target. Starts at the approximately 1-second observation; targeting pulses, recharge and deployment are excluded.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemy Target Profile
numericContextInputs.description: Enemy for target estimates. Profiles group game-file NPC declarations by role, health base and armor base, labelled with the factions that use them most. Named entries are a sample of named bosses, one per main faction, with the mission whose scripts reference them; whether they spawn there with these values, and with which role override, is not established.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemy Difficulty
numericContextInputs.description: Mission difficulty for target estimates.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemy Group Size
numericContextInputs.description: Number of players the enemy is scaled for.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemy Hit Rate (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Share of the enemy's shots that hit you, for time to armor break. Starts at a flat 50%; Shade-Tech in-game counts found about 70% within 15 m and 30% beyond for a normal enemy.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemies Attacking
numericContextInputs.description: Enemies of the selected target firing at you at once.

numericContextInputs.name: Enemy Firing Time (%)
numericContextInputs.description: Share of the time the enemy spends firing. Enemies fire in bursts, move and reload, with pauses that the game data does not yet describe; testers judge they fire under half the time, so it starts at 50% (G428). 100% is continuous fire.

stats.name: DTOC
stats.description: Damage to Targets Out of Cover from modeled rolls, mods and talents. While the Target Out of Cover assumption is on, Out of Cover Damage Factor applies it to weapon damage in the enemy target estimates (bodyshots and time to kill, and the weapon part of Build Time to Kill) as its own multiplier, like Health Damage and Damage to Armor. That placement follows the community damage formula and needs live-game verification. Skills, Build DPS and weapon DPS previews are unchanged.

stats.name: Critical Hit Chance
stats.description: Critical Hit Chance bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed Vindictive effects. This is not a final probability, is not clamped to a game cap, and does not calculate critical-hit damage or DPS.

stats.name: Critical Hit Damage
stats.description: Critical Hit Damage bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed Vindictive effects. Critical-hit events and damage are not simulated.

stats.name: Headshot Damage
stats.description: Headshot Damage bonus total, including assumed current Breadbasket stacks for the next headshot. Headshot events are not simulated, and this bonus is not applied to the regular weapon damage preview.

stats.name: Weapon Handling
stats.description: Weapon Handling bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed current Braced, On Empty, or Unwavering effects. Contributes 1:1 to Combined Accuracy, Stability, Reload Speed and Swap Speed. These are bonus totals; recoil, spread, swap timing and aim behavior remain unmodeled.

stats.name: Magazine Size
stats.description: Additional flat magazine rounds from modeled effects. Estimated Weapon Magazine Capacity combines these with selected base capacity and percentage bonuses; base Weapon Magazine Size remains separate.

stats.name: Signature Weapon Damage
stats.description: Signature-weapon damage bonus percentage. Signature weapons and their base damage are not modeled; this does not affect the selected regular weapon preview.

stats.name: Armor
stats.description: Flat armor bonuses, including configured blue cores. Estimated Total Armor combines these with equipped-slot base armor and Total Armor percentage bonuses.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Flat health bonuses from modeled equipment effects. Estimated Total Health combines these with the level-40 base and Health (%) bonuses.

stats.name: Total Armor
stats.description: Additional armor percentage from modeled effects, applied to equipped base armor plus flat armor bonuses in Estimated Total Armor.

stats.name: Health on Kill
stats.description: Health recovery percentage per kill from modeled effects. Applied to Estimated Total Health in the potential per-kill recovery estimate. Kill frequency and missing health are not inferred.

stats.name: Skill Tier
stats.description: Skill Tier bonuses from modeled effects, including Technician Amped and assumed Future Perfect stacks. This is an uncapped bonus total; selected skill previews clamp effective tier to 0-6. Overcharge and general skill output scaling are not calculated.

stats.name: Reload Speed
stats.description: Direct reload-speed percentage bonuses from modeled effects. Combined with Weapon Handling in Combined Reload Speed and applied to selected base reload time in Estimated Weapon Reload Time. Base Weapon Reload Time remains unchanged.

stats.name: Stability
stats.description: Stability bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed current Steady Handed or Stabilize stacks. No recoil or handling simulation is performed, and this bonus is not applied to the weapon preview.

stats.name: Accuracy
stats.description: Accuracy bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed current Steady Handed, Stabilize, or Outsider effects. No spread or hit-accuracy simulation is performed, and this bonus is not applied to the weapon preview.

stats.name: Optimal Range
stats.description: Optimal Range percentage bonus total from modeled effects, including assumed current Outsider effects and Near Sighted's penalty. This is distinct from Weapon Optimal Range, which is a weapon-specific distance in meters; Estimated Weapon Optimal Range (m) applies this bonus to selected base range. Damage falloff, maximum range and target distance are not inferred.

stats.name: Rate of Fire
stats.description: Positive and negative rate-of-fire percentage bonuses from modeled effects, including the selected Measured phase. Applied additively to the selected weapon's base RPM in Estimated Weapon Rate of Fire. Firing events, reloads and DPS are not simulated.

stats.name: Skill Haste
stats.description: Raw Skill Haste percentage from modeled effects. Combined Skill Haste adds Skill Efficiency once for the 14 allowlisted damaging-skill relative cooldown factors; these previews do not apply a base cooldown.

stats.name: Skill Damage
stats.description: Skill Damage bonus percentage from modeled effects, including assumed In Sync and Spike buffs. Consumed by selected skill damage estimates together with tier, Skill Efficiency, Total Skill Damage and skill amplification.

stats.name: Repair Skills
stats.description: Repair Skills bonus percentage from modeled effects, including the assumed Reformation buff. Final repair and skill outputs are not calculated.

stats.name: Outgoing Healing
stats.description: Outgoing-healing bonus percentage from modeled effects. Final healing and skill outputs are not calculated.

stats.name: Magazine Size (%)
stats.description: Total modeled magazine percentage bonuses, including the base-only subset. Estimated Weapon Magazine Capacity applies ordinary bonuses to base plus flat rounds and the base-only subset just to base capacity. Stacking needs live-game verification.

stats.name: Health (%)
stats.description: Additional health percentage from modeled effects, applied to the level-40 base plus flat health bonuses in Estimated Total Health.

stats.name: Armor on Kill (%)
stats.description: Armor recovery percentage per kill from modeled effects. Combined with flat Armor on Kill and Estimated Total Armor in the potential per-kill recovery estimate. Kill frequency and missing armor are not inferred.

stats.name: Weapon First Shell Reload (s)
stats.description: Seconds to load the first shell of a reload from empty, for weapons that reload shell by shell (game-file myInitialShellReloadTimeMS, Shade-Tech R18). Zero for other weapons. Used by Estimated Weapon Reload Time.

stats.name: Weapon Per-Shell Reload (s)
stats.description: Seconds per further shell for weapons that reload shell by shell (game-file myReloadTimeMS, Shade-Tech R18). Zero for other weapons, whose Estimated Weapon Reload Time uses the base reload time instead.

stats.name: Armor Repair per Depletion (%)
stats.description: Armor repair percentage of maximum armor per asserted eligible armor-depletion trigger. Trigger availability is asserted manually; armor state and cooldown are not inferred.

stats.name: Armor Repair per Headshot (%)
stats.description: Armor repair percentage of maximum armor per asserted eligible headshot from cover while below the talent's armor threshold. Trigger and cooldown are not inferred.

stats.name: Missing Armor Repair per Crit (%)
stats.description: Armor repair percentage of missing armor per eligible critical hit under the asserted mutually exclusive Clutch state. Critical-hit events and repair are not simulated.

stats.name: Armor Repair over 5s per Kill (%)
stats.description: Per-kill armor-repair budget as a percentage of maximum armor delivered over five seconds for the asserted selected-weapon kill type. This is not a retained healing buff or tick simulation.

stats.name: Prototype Items
stats.description: Active equipped Prototype items (G390). A Prototype attribute rolls from the item's previous maximum to its Prototype maximum (the catalog's proto_max, 1.5 x for most attributes); a Prototype Skill Tier core counts 1.5 tiers. Exotics can't be Prototype. Rounding of the maxima is unverified in game.

stats.name: Quantum Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Quantum augment values (G390): "When taking damage, provides a X chance of becoming immune to damage for 2s", where X is 1.6% at level 1 to 4.3% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Its effect is not modeled; the value is shown for reference.

stats.name: Echo Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Echo augment values (G390): "Every bullet fired has a X chance to deal its damage twice", where X is 1.2% at level 1 to 3.0% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Multiplies practical damage per shot by 1 + the chance, the expected value of hits dealing their damage twice.

stats.name: Atomize Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Atomize augment values (G390): "Increases Grenade Radius and Damage by X", where X is 12.5% at level 1 to 21.5% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Its effect is not modeled; the value is shown for reference.

stats.name: Amalgam Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Amalgam augment values (G390): "Every bullet fired has a X chance to apply a random Status Effect. Cooldown: 5 seconds", where X is 1.6% at level 1 to 4.3% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Its effect is not modeled; the value is shown for reference.

stats.name: Trapper Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Trapper augment values (G390): "Increases Status Effect Duration by X", where X is 5.0% at level 1 to 14.0% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Adds to Status Effect Duration, which lengthens status duration references but not status damage.

stats.name: Entropy Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Entropy augment values (G390): "Health is increased by X of your base Total Armor", where X is 5.0% at level 1 to 14.0% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Adds this share of Estimated Total Armor to Estimated Total Health.

stats.name: Anomaly Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Anomaly augment values (G390): "Receive healing of X of the damage dealt by your Skills", where X is 4.0% at level 1 to 8.5% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Its effect is not modeled; the value is shown for reference.

stats.name: Paradox Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Paradox augment values (G390): "Provides a X chance of refilling your Magazine by 2 for each bullet fired", where X is 1.5% at level 1 to 6.0% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Each bullet refills 2 rounds with this chance, so practical reload-cycle DPS stretches the magazine by 1 / (1 - 2 x chance).

stats.name: Synesthesia Augment
stats.description: Sum of the equipped Prototype items' Synesthesia augment values (G390): "Provides a X chance of reducing Skill Cooldowns by 0.2s for each bullet hit", where X is 5.0% at level 1 to 14.0% at level 10. Copies on several items add, up to the six gear pieces and the active weapon. Raids, the Incursion and the Toxic Dark Zone disable augments. Its effect is not modeled; the value is shown for reference.

stats.name: Status Effect Duration
stats.description: Status effect duration bonus that does not raise status damage: a Prototype Trapper augment's value (G393). Added to Combined Status Effects in status duration references only; its additive placement is unverified.

stats.name: Weapon Damage Multiplier
stats.description: Raw multiplier for modeled weapon damage effects such as Glass Cannon (1.0 means unchanged; 1.25 means 25% more weapon damage). This affects the equipped weapon damage preview only; it does not model skill damage.

stats.name: Out of Cover Damage Factor
stats.description: 1 plus Damage to Targets Out of Cover while the Target Out of Cover assumption is on, otherwise 1 (G374). Multiplies weapon damage in the enemy target estimates; its separate-multiplier placement follows the community damage formula and needs live-game verification.

stats.name: Selected Weapon Requires No Reload
stats.description: One when the selected owning weapon has Bullet Hell selected, otherwise zero. A permanent talent property, not an assumed buff or an infinite-ammo claim. The reload-cycle DPS preview uses firing DPS without a reload penalty. Ammo reserves, hit-driven replenishment, allies, dry firing and encounter uptime are not simulated.

stats.name: Estimated Combustion Burn Damage Factor (% base)
stats.description: Estimated separate 1.25 Burn-only factor at four Ember Engine pieces while combustion_initial_burn_debuff=true asserts the initial-Burn debuff. No chance, ticks, debuff lifetime or generic target eligibility is inferred. Stacking needs live verification.

stats.name: Headshot Amplification
stats.description: Separate modeled headshot-only amplification, Mantis's In Plain Sight and an explicitly asserted eligible Hotshot MMR shot against an asserted target not targeting you. Multiplies estimated regular and critical headshots after their additive shot bonuses; does not change bodyshots, raw Headshot Damage or skill damage. Weakpoints, Decoy cooldown resets and target detection are not modeled. Pinned catalog and historical Ubisoft TU10 developer notes; verify current game behavior.

stats.name: Skill Damage Multiplier
stats.description: Outgoing skill amplification from Glass Cannon, Spotter against an assumed pulsed target, and Opportunistic against an assumed debuffed target. Weapon-only amplification is excluded. Consumed by selected damaging skill estimates; raw Skill Damage and Total Skill Damage remain separate.

stats.name: Incoming Damage Multiplier
stats.description: Raw incoming-damage multiplier from modeled effects (1.0 means unchanged; 1.5 means 50% more damage taken). Incoming damage events and mitigation are not simulated.

stats.name: Total Weapon Damage
stats.description: Context-gated total weapon damage bonus from selected talents, including Measured's selected bottom-half bonus. It is applied multiplicatively after the modeled additive weapon-damage category in the equipped weapon preview.

stats.name: Total Skill Damage
stats.description: Context-gated Total Skill Damage bonus from modeled gear talents and gear-set thresholds. Kept separate from Skill Damage and consumed multiplicatively by selected skill damage estimates.

stats.name: Total Skill Repair
stats.description: Assumption-based Total Skill Repair bonus from modeled gear talents and gear-set thresholds. Kept separate from Repair Skills and consumed multiplicatively by selected healing-skill reference estimates; recipient state and actual healing are not simulated.

stats.name: Bonus Armor (%)
stats.description: Sum of asserted modeled self bonus-armor fractions, shown as a raw percentage of the agent's armor. Estimated Bonus Armor converts this fraction using estimated maximum armor; incoming damage and protection are not simulated. This does not change estimated armor, health, weapon previews, or DPS, and does not automatically activate Intimidate or any other assumption.

stats.name: Base-Only Magazine Bonus
stats.description: Subset of Magazine Size (%) explicitly described as base magazine capacity: Overflowing variants and Pakhan. Already included in the total, so it is subtracted from ordinary scaling and applied once to the selected base. Preserves the original aggregate bonus and talent provenance.

stats.name: Estimated Weapon Magazine Capacity
stats.formula: weapon_magazine_size > 0 ? (weapon_magazine_size <= 2 ? weapon_magazine_size : floor(max(0, ((magazine_size_percent - base_magazine_size_percent) > 0 ? (weapon_magazine_size + magazine_size) + max(1, (weapon_magazine_size + magazine_size) * (magazine_size_percent - base_magazine_size_percent)) : ((magazine_size_percent - base_magazine_size_percent) < 0 ? weapon_magazine_size + min(-1, weapon_magazine_size * (magazine_size_percent - base_magazine_size_percent)) + magazine_size : (weapon_magazine_size + magazine_size))) + weapon_magazine_size * base_magazine_size_percent))) : 0
stats.description: Estimated rounds, following the game's ClipSizeFinal (G351, Shade-Tech trace): a base of 1 or 2 rounds never changes. Otherwise flat rounds add to the base, and a positive percentage bonus then adds at least one round: (base + flat) + max(1, (base + flat) x percent). A negative percentage applies to the base only, removing at least one round. Base-only bonuses (Overflowing, Pakhan) add base x bonus. The total is floored to whole rounds and clamps at zero; a missing base yields zero. In-game cards confirm the flat branch (Vindicator 40, Iron Lung 85, Bittersweet 20) and the percent minimum (Dread Edict 16 with a 9% roll). Excludes chambered rounds, ammo reserves, reload/refill events and DPS. Frenzy and On Point capacity assumptions remain manual.

stats.name: Equipped Base Armor
stats.description: Sum of rounded level-40 base armor for equipped armor slots, including each item's installed Expertise grade at 1% of that slot's base per grade. Six unupgraded pieces total 660,000 before blue cores and percentage bonuses. Exact in-game totals may differ by a few points.

stats.name: Level-40 Base Health
stats.description: Community-reported level-40 health before equipment and SHD Watch: 270,000. Automatic SHD health is a separate flat Health contribution, not part of this base. Not independently verified against the live game.

stats.name: Estimated Total Armor
stats.description: Estimated armor: (equipped slot base armor including per-item Expertise + flat Armor bonuses) multiplied by 1 + Total Armor bonuses including SHD Watch. Expertise never multiplies blue cores. Rounded community slot values still need live-game verification. Excludes unmodeled talents, temporary bonus armor, and normalization.

stats.name: Estimated Total Health
stats.description: Estimated health: (community-reported level-40 base of 270,000 + flat Health including 30 per SHD level capped at 2,000) multiplied by 1 + Health (%) including SHD Watch upgrades, plus a Prototype Entropy augment's share of total armor (G393; added after Health (%), an unverified placement). Applying SHD flat health before percentage bonuses needs live-game verification. Excludes unmodeled talents and seasonal effects.

stats.name: Estimated Weapon Rate of Fire
stats.description: Selected weapon base RPM multiplied by 1 plus the modeled Rate of Fire bonus total, floored at zero. Includes explicit current talent/set assumptions and gear bonuses; inactive weapon talents do not contribute. Base Weapon Rate of Fire remains unchanged. No weapon selection or no modeled base RPM yields zero. This estimate does not simulate firing, magazine phases, reloads, burst behavior, firing caps or DPS; source values and additive stacking need live-game verification.

stats.name: Combined Reload Speed
stats.description: Direct Reload Speed plus Weapon Handling, using the 1:1 handling contribution documented in Ubisoft's TU10 notes. Raw inputs remain separate. Includes only modeled effects and explicitly assumed current buffs; stacking and current game behavior need live-game verification.

stats.name: Estimated Weapon Reload Time
stats.formula: 1 + effective_reload_speed > 0 ? (weapon_reload_per_shell > 0 ? (weapon_reload_first_shell + weapon_reload_per_shell * max(0, equipped_weapon_magazine_size - 1)) : weapon_reload_time) / (1 + effective_reload_speed) : 0
stats.description: Estimated seconds to reload from empty, divided by 1 plus Combined Reload Speed (weapon handling and reload speed add in one divisor, confirmed in game). A weapon that reloads shell by shell (G378) takes first shell + per shell x (estimated magazine capacity - 1), so magazine bonuses lengthen it; its end animation is not added. Other weapons use their base reload time, the empty-magazine reload. Zero indicates no modeled selected base time or an unsupported nonpositive speed factor. Uses existing current-buff assumptions; no reload events, partial reloads or reload cancels are modeled. Verify in game.

stats.name: Configured Weapon Cores
stats.description: Counts valid configured gear core rolls, once per core attribute. Unconfigured or invalid rolls, Expertise and bonuses from sets, talents or specialization do not count. Used by Core Exercise conversion, Memento's asserted short-term buff and, for Weapon cores, Clutch's available post-kill window.

stats.name: Configured Skill Tier Cores
stats.description: Counts valid configured gear core rolls, once per core attribute. Unconfigured or invalid rolls, Expertise and bonuses from sets, talents or specialization do not count. Used by Core Exercise conversion, Memento's asserted short-term buff and, for Weapon cores, Clutch's available post-kill window.

stats.name: Estimated Charging Skill Protection (%)
stats.description: Cavalier-only incoming skill-damage protection from explicitly retained qualifying charge seconds, capped at the available selected limit. Four effective pieces required. Not general Damage Resistance; combat, cover, Charged sharing and actual hits are not inferred.

stats.name: Charging Skill Damage Factor (% base)
stats.description: Standalone Cavalier layer: 100% means unchanged skill damage, 50% means half remains, 30% means 70% protection. Based only on the supplied retained charge estimate. Other resistance layers, Glass Cannon, target source, incoming hits and actual damage taken are excluded. Does not change the general incoming-damage multiplier.

stats.name: Charging Full Charge Time From Zero (s)
stats.description: Available full-charge time from zero under uninterrupted eligible combat/out-of-cover charging: 10s base, 14s with Overcharging, 5s with Safe Charging, 7s with both. Four effective pieces required; zero outside that threshold. Independent of the retained-progress assumption. Not remaining time, an active timer, Charged duration or a simulation of pauses/consumption.

stats.name: Estimated Stoic Resistance (%)
stats.description: Four-piece Aegis resistance estimate from explicit qualifying player targets and additional eligible Decoy targets with selected Deceit. Uses 4% per target, or 5% with selected Polyethylene Plating, and the assumed 1.X group multiplier. Combined targets are bounded at eight for this planner estimate, not asserted as a verified live cap. Adds to raw Damage Resistance; live protection stacking, hits and damage taken are not simulated.

stats.name: Configured Armor Cores
stats.description: Counts valid configured blue core rolls on equipped gear, independently of armor amount. Unconfigured or invalid rolls do not count. Core Exercise uses this count for cross-core conversion. Deflector Shield uses this count plus Skill Tier, capped at six.

stats.name: Equipped Weapon Damage
stats.description: Estimated weapon damage: weapon base damage multiplied by 1 plus modeled all-weapon damage and matching weapon-type damage bonuses, then by modeled weapon damage and context-active total-weapon-damage multipliers. Includes rolls and mods from the selected weapon, gear, sets, and specialization weapon-type bonuses, plus the weapon-preview effects of Glass Cannon and modeled conditional talents. SHD Watch and selected-weapon Expertise are included in the additive damage category. Target-state talent bonuses require the corresponding explicit assumption. Excludes skill damage including Spotter's skill amplification, unmodeled talents and specialization effects, other target bonuses, critical hits, headshots, and procs. Select a weapon slot in the assumptions row.
stats.formula: weapon_base_damage * (1 + weapon_damage + assault_rifle_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_assault_rifle') + lmg_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_lmg') + smg_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_smg') + rifle_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_rifle') + marksman_rifle_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_marksman_rifle') + shotgun_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_shotgun') + pistol_damage * has_selected_tag('weapon_type_pistol')) * weapon_damage_multiplier * (1 + total_weapon_damage)

stats.name: Estimated Weapon Optimal Range (m)
stats.description: Selected weapon base optimal range in meters multiplied by 1 plus the modeled additive Optimal Range bonus total. Includes eligible mods and current owner-scoped talents such as Outsider and Near Sighted. Base range and raw percentage bonuses remain separate. No selected base range yields zero. This is a distance estimate, not damage falloff, maximum range, effective accuracy or target distance; it does not set Ranger's distance assumption. Catalog values, named-item baselines and additive scaling need current in-game verification.

stats.name: Enemy Target Role
stats.description: Role of the selected enemy profile: 1 normal, 2 veteran, 3 elite, 4 named; 0 without a target.

stats.name: Enemy Scaling Scenario
stats.description: Row of the difficulty x group-size scaling table: (difficulty - 1) x 4 + players.

stats.name: Enemy Health Scaling
stats.formula: enemy_target_role_index >= 3.5 ? curve('npc_named_health_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 2.5 ? curve('npc_elite_health_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 1.5 ? curve('npc_veteran_health_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 0.5 ? curve('npc_normal_health_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : 0
stats.description: HealthFinal with the base set to 1, for the target role, difficulty and group size. Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Enemy Armor Scaling
stats.formula: enemy_target_role_index >= 3.5 ? curve('npc_named_armor_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 2.5 ? curve('npc_elite_armor_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 1.5 ? curve('npc_veteran_armor_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 0.5 ? curve('npc_normal_armor_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : 0
stats.description: NPCArmorFinal with the base set to 1, for the target role, difficulty and group size. Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Enemy Target Health
stats.description: Selected profile health base x health scaling. Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Enemy Target Armor
stats.description: Selected profile armor base x armor scaling (special-role armor for veteran, elite and named). Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Estimated Bodyshots to Kill
stats.formula: enemy_target_health > 0 && (equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage * out_of_cover_damage_factor) > 0 && 1 + damage_to_armor > 0 && 1 + health_damage > 0 ? ceil(enemy_target_armor / ((equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage * out_of_cover_damage_factor) * (1 + damage_to_armor)) + enemy_target_health / ((equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage * out_of_cover_damage_factor) * (1 + health_damage))) : 0
stats.description: Average bodyshots (crit chance weighted) to remove the target's armor, with Damage to Armor, then its health, with Health Damage; damage carries over between the pools. Every shot hits the body. Damage to Targets Out of Cover applies while the Target Out of Cover assumption is on. Excludes headshots, falloff, cover protection, damage resistance and armor plating. Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Estimated Magazines to Kill
stats.description: Bodyshots to kill divided by estimated magazine capacity.

stats.name: Estimated Time to Kill (s)
stats.formula: equipped_weapon_target_bodyshots > 0 && equipped_weapon_rpm > 0 && equipped_weapon_magazine_size > 0 ? (equipped_weapon_target_bodyshots - 1) * 60 / equipped_weapon_rpm + (weapon_no_reload > 0 ? 0 : max(0, ceil(equipped_weapon_target_bodyshots / equipped_weapon_magazine_size) - 1) * equipped_weapon_reload_time) : 0
stats.description: Seconds from the first shot to the killing shot, starting with a full magazine: shot intervals at estimated RPM plus one estimated reload per emptied magazine (none for Bullet Hell). Uses the bodyshots-to-kill assumptions. Source formula evaluation at level 40 PvE, not an in-game observation; which declaration a mission spawns is not established.

stats.name: Enemy Weapon Damage Scaling
stats.formula: enemy_target_role_index >= 3.5 ? curve('npc_named_weapon_damage_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 2.5 ? curve('npc_elite_weapon_damage_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 1.5 ? curve('npc_veteran_weapon_damage_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : enemy_target_role_index >= 0.5 ? curve('npc_normal_weapon_damage_multiplier', enemy_target_scenario_index) : 0
stats.description: NPCWeaponDamageModFinal for the target role, difficulty and group size.

stats.name: Enemy Hit Damage
stats.description: Damage of one hit from the target's weapon before your mitigation: myDamageMax x weapon damage scaling, floored, as the game files compute it. The weapon is the target's representative primary weapon from the game files; which weapon a spawned enemy carries, its pauses between bursts and its aim are not established, so hit rate and firing time are assumptions.

stats.name: Enemy Incoming DPS
stats.formula: enemy_target_hit_damage * curve('npc_target_weapon_rpm', context_value('enemy_target')) / 60 * context_value('enemy_hit_rate') / 100 * context_value('enemy_firing_share') / 100 * context_value('enemy_attackers')
stats.description: Damage per second you take from the attacking enemies before mitigation: hit damage x fire rate x hit rate x firing time x enemies attacking. The weapon is the target's representative primary weapon from the game files; which weapon a spawned enemy carries, its pauses between bursts and its aim are not established, so hit rate and firing time are assumptions.

stats.name: Your Damage Taken vs Target
stats.description: Share of the target's damage you take: the damage taken multiplier, and Protection from Elites against elite and named enemies.

stats.name: Time to Armor Break (s)
stats.formula: enemy_target_incoming_dps > 0 && (max(0, character_armor) + max(0, estimated_bonus_armor)) > 0 ? (max(0, character_armor) + max(0, estimated_bonus_armor)) / (enemy_target_incoming_dps * enemy_damage_taken_factor) : 0
stats.description: Seconds for the attacking enemies to break your armor and bonus armor, the mirror of time to kill. Excludes armor regeneration, repairs and kits. The weapon is the target's representative primary weapon from the game files; which weapon a spawned enemy carries, its pauses between bursts and its aim are not established, so hit rate and firing time are assumptions.

stats.name: Time to Down (s)
stats.formula: enemy_target_incoming_dps > 0 ? ((max(0, character_armor) + max(0, estimated_bonus_armor)) + max(0, character_health)) / (enemy_target_incoming_dps * enemy_damage_taken_factor) : 0
stats.description: Seconds for the attacking enemies to remove your armor, bonus armor and health. Excludes regeneration, healing and kits. The weapon is the target's representative primary weapon from the game files; which weapon a spawned enemy carries, its pauses between bursts and its aim are not established, so hit rate and firing time are assumptions.

stats.name: Estimated Weapon Long Range (m)
stats.description: Selected weapon game-file long range in meters (myRangeLong), multiplied by 1 plus the modeled Optimal Range bonus total, as the game's RangeLongFinal uses the same bonuses as optimal range. Beyond this range the game file describes minimum damage; the damage floor and the falloff shape between optimal and long range are not modeled. Zero when the weapon has no reviewed game-file mapping. See division-2-weapon-source-fields.json.

stats.name: Weapon Maximum Range (m)
stats.description: Selected weapon game-file maximum range in meters (myRangeMax), beyond which the game file describes no damage. Range bonuses do not change it. Some weapons list a long range above this value; both are shown as recorded. Zero when the weapon has no reviewed game-file mapping.

stats.name: Estimated Tactical Reload Time
stats.description: Estimated seconds to reload with rounds still in the magazine: the game-file myReloadTimeMS divided by 1 plus Combined Reload Speed. Estimated Weapon Reload Time uses the community value, which matches the empty-magazine channel. Applying reload speed to this channel the same way is a planner interpretation. Zero for per-shell, cylinder and unmapped weapons.

stats.name: Critical Hit Repair Share
stats.description: Share of a critical hit's damage repaired to you and allies, such as Caduceus's 3% (G403).

stats.name: Estimated Critical Hit Repair per Second
stats.formula: weapon_crit_repair_share * practical_hit_fraction * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance)) * ((1 - practical_headshot_fraction) * max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_damage) + practical_headshot_fraction * max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage)) * max(0, equipped_weapon_rpm) / 60
stats.description: Average repair per second while firing: the share of each landed critical hit's damage, with the practical hit rate and headshot share. Before missing-armor limits; also reaches allies (G403).

stats.name: Shield Repair Share of Damage
stats.description: Share of this weapon's damage repaired to your deployed shield, such as Symbiosis's 25% (G403).

stats.name: Estimated Shield Repair per Second
stats.description: Shield repair per second while firing: the share of practical firing DPS. Symbiosis's 10% shield health loss per second is not subtracted (G403).

stats.name: Armor Repair per Kill
stats.description: Armor repaired per kill, as a share of maximum armor, such as Doctor Home's 50% armor kit for the party (G403).

stats.name: Estimated Armor Repair per Kill

stats.name: Estimated Kill Repair per Second
stats.description: Per-kill repair at the expected kill rate against the selected enemy while firing (G400). Zero without a target (G403).

stats.name: Armor Repair per Cover Move

stats.name: Estimated Armor Repair per Cover Move

stats.name: Grenade Capacity
stats.description: Extra grenades carried, such as Hoarder's +3 (G402). Shown for reference; no estimate reads it yet.

stats.name: Grenade Radius
stats.description: Grenade blast radius bonus, such as Hoarder's +50% (G402). Shown for reference; no estimate reads it yet.

stats.name: Grenade Damage
stats.description: Grenade damage bonus, such as Hoarder's +35% and +25% per extra enemy in the blast (G402). Shown for reference; no estimate reads it yet.

stats.name: Hive Skill Haste
stats.description: Skill haste for Hives only, such as Transference Overclock's 15% per Skill Tier (G402). Shown for reference; no estimate reads it yet.

stats.name: Movement Speed
stats.description: Movement speed bonus from modeled talents, such as Sport Mode (G398). Shown for reference; no estimate reads it.

stats.name: Party Bonus Armor
stats.description: Bonus armor from party members' ticked buffs (G394), such as Vanguard's share of the giver's armor. Each is evaluated against the giving member's build; the same buff from several members applies once, the strongest. Uptime, duration and decay are not simulated.

stats.name: Estimated Bonus Armor
stats.formula: max(0, character_armor) * max(0, bonus_armor_percent) + max(0, party_bonus_armor)
stats.description: Estimated maximum armor times the asserted self bonus-armor fraction, plus bonus armor granted by party members' ticked buffs (G394). Separate from maximum armor; does not infer current bonus armor, decay, damage absorption or automatic talent activation. Raw bonuses remain separate. Baselines and additive scaling are planner estimates pending current in-game verification. Incoming Repairs, Repair Skills and Skill Efficiency do not amplify these estimates.

stats.name: Estimated Armor Regeneration / Second
stats.description: Flat armor regeneration plus estimated maximum armor times percentage regeneration. A potential per-second rate under current assumptions; missing armor, damage interruptions, timers and actual recovery are not simulated. Raw bonuses remain separate. Baselines and additive scaling are planner estimates pending current in-game verification. Incoming Repairs, Repair Skills and Skill Efficiency do not amplify these estimates.

stats.name: Estimated Armor Restored / Kill
stats.description: Flat Armor on Kill plus estimated maximum armor times percentage Armor on Kill. Potential immediate self recovery for an eligible kill, before missing-armor limits; excludes delayed talent repairs, kill frequency and bonus-armor conversion. Raw bonuses remain separate. Baselines and additive scaling are planner estimates pending current in-game verification. Incoming Repairs, Repair Skills and Skill Efficiency do not amplify these estimates.

stats.name: Estimated Health Restored / Kill
stats.description: Estimated maximum health times percentage Health on Kill. Potential self recovery for an eligible kill, before missing-health limits; kill frequency and current health are not inferred. Raw bonuses remain separate. Baselines and additive scaling are planner estimates pending current in-game verification. Incoming Repairs, Repair Skills and Skill Efficiency do not amplify these estimates.

stats.name: Damage Taken Multiplier
stats.description: Share of incoming damage taken after Damage Resistance (Aegis, Challenger, Rebalance and similar), as the game's DamageTakenModFinal: reductions add up and are capped at 90%. Only reductions the build asserts are counted. The pools and caps follow the game's formulas as traced from the game files; the order in which the engine combines the layers, and whether every layer applies to armor and health alike, are not in the data. Excludes regeneration, healing, armor kits, hit zones and cover.

stats.name: Effective HP
stats.formula: (max(0, character_armor) + max(0, estimated_bonus_armor) + max(0, character_health)) / effective_damage_taken
stats.description: Damage the agent can take before going down: (armor + bonus armor + health) divided by the damage taken multiplier. Armor absorbs damage before health. The pools and caps follow the game's formulas as traced from the game files; the order in which the engine combines the layers, and whether every layer applies to armor and health alike, are not in the data. Excludes regeneration, healing, armor kits, hit zones and cover.

stats.name: Effective HP vs Elites
stats.description: Effective HP against elite and named enemies: Protection from Elites is the game's separate DamageTakenFromElitesModFinal multiplier, floored at 0.2. The pools and caps follow the game's formulas as traced from the game files; the order in which the engine combines the layers, and whether every layer applies to armor and health alike, are not in the data. Excludes regeneration, healing, armor kits, hit zones and cover.

stats.name: Effective HP vs Explosives
stats.description: Effective HP against explosive damage: Explosive Resistance is the game's blast damage-type mitigation, capped at 90%. The pools and caps follow the game's formulas as traced from the game files; the order in which the engine combines the layers, and whether every layer applies to armor and health alike, are not in the data. Excludes regeneration, healing, armor kits, hit zones and cover.

stats.name: Estimated Clutch Armor Repair / Crit
stats.description: One eligible selected Clutch or Perfect Clutch critical hit repairs 2.5% of assumed missing armor: estimated maximum armor times Clutch Missing Armor (%) divided by 100 times 0.025. The existing repair-state selector separately asserts low-armor or current post-kill eligibility; armor thresholds and timers are not inferred. No supplied missing-armor assumption yields zero. Raw repair fraction and maximum armor remain separate. Incoming Repairs, Repair Skills and Skill Efficiency are excluded. No critical probability, repeated hits, time-to-heal or actual repair sequence is calculated. Pinned catalog conversion, pending in-game verification.
