stats.name: Estimated Magazine Bodyshot Damage
stats.description: Average bodyshot damage times estimated full magazine capacity, with current buffs held fixed for every round. Assumes eligible landed bodyshots; excludes phase transitions, changing ammo-dependent bonuses, refills, misses, headshots, mitigation, range and proc uptime.

stats.name: Estimated Magazine Firing Duration
stats.description: Estimated magazine capacity divided by estimated rounds per second. Uses N firing intervals for a repeatable magazine/reload cycle, not the N-minus-one interval from first shot to last shot. Zero cadence yields zero. Excludes trigger/burst limits, pauses, phase changes and refills; seconds.

stats.name: Estimated Reload-Cycle Bodyshot DPS
stats.description: For a selected Bullet Hell weapon, firing bodyshot DPS without a reload penalty; otherwise conventional full-magazine damage divided by firing duration plus one modeled reload. Current buffs and crit probability are held fixed throughout repeated cycles. The conventional branch requires positive capacity, cadence and reload time; unavailable inputs yield zero. No-reload firing still requires positive cadence and damage. Ignores ammo reserves, hit-based replenishment, automatic refills and other reload skips, per-shell timing, changing ammo bonuses, phase transitions, trigger/burst limits, misses, mitigation, range and proc uptime. A reference cycle, not simulated encounter DPS; verify in game.

stats.name: Estimated Bodyshot DPS While Firing
stats.description: Average bodyshot damage times estimated rounds per second, at the selected weapon catalog cadence with current modeled buffs held fixed. Assumes every shot lands as an eligible bodyshot. Excludes reload downtime, trigger or burst limits, phase transitions, misses, headshots, target mitigation, range and proc uptime. A firing-rate estimate, not sustained encounter DPS; verify in game.

stats.name: Effective Critical Hit Chance
stats.description: Modeled Critical Hit Chance clamped to the community-reported 0–60% probability range. Raw bonuses, including negative magazine-phase effects and amounts above the cap, remain unchanged. This estimates the chance per eligible landed shot, not actual encounter crit frequency or talent uptime.

stats.name: Estimated Average Bodyshot Damage
stats.description: Probability-weighted regular and critical bodyshot damage using Effective Critical Hit Chance. A long-run estimate for eligible landed bodyshots under the current modeled buff assumptions; it does not simulate random outcomes, proc generation or buff uptime. Shot-specific talent assumptions must match the bodyshots being examined. Excludes headshots, target mitigation, range, misses and DPS; verify in game.

stats.name: Weapon Critical Hit Damage
stats.description: Community-reported innate 25% critical damage plus modeled Critical Hit Damage bonuses. Raw bonus totals remain separate. Used for the estimated critical shots; chance, events and target mitigation are excluded. Reference: Vikeman45, Weapon Damage 101: Bullet Damage (2020, updated 2025); current live-game verification remains needed.

stats.name: Weapon Headshot Damage
stats.description: Selected weapon catalog headshot bonus plus modeled Headshot Damage bonuses from gear, rolls, mods, sets and current talent assumptions. The weapon base changes with the preview selection; raw bonuses remain separate.

stats.name: Estimated Critical Bodyshot Damage
stats.description: Estimated damage conditional on a critical bodyshot: regular weapon damage times 1 plus total Critical Hit Damage. Does not predict crit probability, target armor/health, range, resistance, procs or DPS. Current modeled buffs apply; verify estimates in game.

stats.name: Estimated Headshot Damage
stats.description: Estimated noncritical headshot: regular weapon damage times 1 plus the selected weapon base headshot bonus and modeled Headshot Damage bonuses, then headshot-only amplification. Excludes target mitigation, headshot eligibility, range, procs and DPS. Verify estimates in game.

stats.name: Practical Damage per Shot
stats.formula: max(0, practical_base_shot_damage) * max(0, 1 + practical_shot_damage_bonus) + max(0, practical_shot_bonus_damage)
stats.description: Expected damage of one fired shot: hit rate x (body share x average bodyshot + headshot share x crit-weighted headshot), x (1 + Echo augment chance) for a hit dealing its damage twice. Uses the Practical Hit Rate and Headshots among Hits assumptions with the current talent assumptions held fixed; misses deal no damage. For shotguns both are shares of the 8 pellets. An editable reference, not simulated encounter DPS.

stats.name: Practical Firing DPS
stats.description: Practical damage per shot at the estimated rate of fire, while firing. Uses the Practical Hit Rate and Headshots among Hits assumptions with the current talent assumptions held fixed; misses deal no damage. For shotguns both are shares of the 8 pellets. An editable reference, not simulated encounter DPS.

stats.name: Practical Reload-Cycle DPS
stats.formula: weapon_no_reload > 0 ? equipped_weapon_practical_firing_dps : (equipped_weapon_firing_duration > 0 && equipped_weapon_reload_time > 0 ? (max(0, equipped_weapon_practical_shot_damage) * max(0, equipped_weapon_magazine_size) * (1 / max(0.05, 1 - practical_rounds_returned_per_shot)) + max(0, practical_magazine_bonus_damage)) / (equipped_weapon_firing_duration * (1 / max(0.05, 1 - practical_rounds_returned_per_shot)) + equipped_weapon_reload_time) : 0)
stats.description: Practical damage of a full magazine over its firing time plus one reload, or firing DPS with no reload (Bullet Hell). Expected returned rounds (Paradox, Boomerang) stretch the magazine and its firing time by 1 / (1 - rounds returned per shot), and once-per-magazine damage (First Blood) is added. Uses the Practical Hit Rate and Headshots among Hits assumptions with the current talent assumptions held fixed; misses deal no damage. For shotguns both are shares of the 8 pellets. An editable reference, not simulated encounter DPS.

stats.name: Pellets per Shot
stats.description: Pellets in one shot of the selected weapon (G414): eight for shotguns, whose listed damage is the total of all eight, and one otherwise. Shade-Tech found 8 bullets per round in every non-named shotgun's game-file fire events and in the Lullaby exotic's, and matched the catalog damage as eight floored pellets; R26 confirmed 8 for every player shotgun, named and exotic. The combat simulator rolls each pellet's hit, headshot and critical hit.

stats.name: Practical Hit Fraction
stats.description: The Practical Hit Rate assumption as a fraction (G399), for talents whose expected effect depends on hits.

stats.name: Practical Headshot Fraction
stats.description: The Headshots among Hits assumption as a fraction (G399).

stats.name: Rounds Returned per Shot
stats.description: Expected rounds put back in the magazine per shot fired (G399): two with a Paradox augment's chance, and Boomerang's chance per critical hit. Stretches practical reload-cycle DPS only.

stats.name: Practical Base Damage per Shot
stats.formula: max(0, min(100, context_value('practical_hit_rate'))) / 100 * ((1 - max(0, min(100, context_value('practical_headshot_share'))) / 100) * max(0, equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage) + max(0, min(100, context_value('practical_headshot_share'))) / 100 * (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance)))) * max(0, 1 + augment_echo)
stats.description: Expected damage of one fired shot before talents that empower shots (G400): hit rate x (body share x average bodyshot + headshot share x crit-weighted headshot), x (1 + Echo augment chance). Sets the expected kill rate. Uses the Practical Hit Rate and Headshots among Hits assumptions with the current talent assumptions held fixed; misses deal no damage. For shotguns both are shares of the 8 pellets. An editable reference, not simulated encounter DPS.

stats.name: Practical Shots to Kill
stats.formula: enemy_target_health > 0 && (max(0, practical_base_shot_damage) * out_of_cover_damage_factor) > 0 && 1 + damage_to_armor > 0 && 1 + health_damage > 0 ? enemy_target_armor / ((max(0, practical_base_shot_damage) * out_of_cover_damage_factor) * (1 + damage_to_armor)) + enemy_target_health / ((max(0, practical_base_shot_damage) * out_of_cover_damage_factor) * (1 + health_damage)) : 0
stats.description: Expected shots fired per kill of the selected enemy target (G400), from the base practical shot: its armor with Damage to Armor, then its health with Health Damage. Zero without a target. Assumes one target at a time and no other damage. Uses the Practical Hit Rate and Headshots among Hits assumptions with the current talent assumptions held fixed; misses deal no damage. For shotguns both are shares of the 8 pellets. An editable reference, not simulated encounter DPS.

stats.name: Practical Kills per Shot
stats.description: Expected kills per shot fired (G400), for kill-triggered talents such as Salvage, Headhunter and Determined. At most one kill per shot; zero without a target.

stats.name: Practical Bonus Damage per Shot
stats.description: Expected extra damage per shot from kill-triggered talents (G400): Headhunter's empowered hit and Determined's guaranteed headshot, each per expected headshot kill. Practical DPS only.

stats.name: Practical Shot Damage Bonus
stats.description: Expected extra damage per shot from talents that empower the next shot (G399), such as Boomerang's bonus after a returned bullet. Applies to practical DPS only.

stats.name: Practical Damage Gained per Magazine
stats.description: Expected extra damage once per magazine (G399), such as First Blood turning the first shot after an empty reload into a headshot. Added to practical reload-cycle DPS only.

stats.name: Estimated Critical Headshot Damage
stats.formula: equipped_weapon_damage * max(0, 1 + weapon_total_critical_hit_damage + weapon_total_headshot_damage) * max(0, headshot_damage_multiplier)
stats.description: Estimated critical headshot: critical and headshot bonuses add together within the shot multiplier, followed by headshot-only amplification. Uses the same regular weapon damage and current buff assumptions; excludes chance, target mitigation, headshot eligibility, range, procs and DPS. Community-reported formula requires current live-game verification.

modifiers.value: practical_kills_per_shot * practical_headshot_fraction * min(1.25 * (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))), (weapon_total_headshot_damage > 1.5 ? 12.5 : 8) * max(0, equipped_weapon_damage))

modifiers.value: practical_kills_per_shot * practical_headshot_fraction * min(1.5 * (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))), (weapon_total_headshot_damage > 1.5 ? 12.5 : 8) * max(0, equipped_weapon_damage))

talents.description: Status effects apply snowfall to target.

talents.name: From the Shadows Into the Light
talents.description: From the Shadows: While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed. Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover. Into the Light: While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4% RPM. Buff does not apply while shooting from cover. While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

talents.name: Ground Control
talents.description: Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor. When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount.

allyEffects.name: Ground Control
allyEffects.description: While the giver is at full armor. The shared repairs are not modeled.

talents.name: Hackstep Protocol
talents.description: Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability. Grants 50% bonus armor for 5s. Hides your nameplate for 5s. Repairs 20% of your armor. Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%. Ability cooldown: 20s.

talents.name: Headache
talents.description: First Headshot with a Marksman Rifle will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a Marksman Rifle will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine. From the fourth headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

talents.name: Heartstopper
talents.description: Headshots apply pulse for 5s. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies add and refresh a stack of +1% bonus armor and +1.1% amplified weapon damage to pulsed enemies for 5s. Max stack is 50. Two stacks are lost per second.

talents.name: Hoarder
talents.description: +3 Grenade Capacity. +50% Grenade Radius. +35% Grenade Damage. +25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast. Automatically regenerate grenades every 30s, if you have less than 2 grenades in your inventory.

talents.name: Huddle
talents.description: Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of the hive or Smart Cover. While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s. Cooldown: 40s. Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown: 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally agent within the range of your hive or smart cover.

talents.name: Impervious
talents.description: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

allyEffects.name: Impervious
allyEffects.description: While the ally is within 10m of the giver.

talents.name: Indirect Transmission
talents.description: On kill: Spread status effects of that enemy to all enemies within 10m. Refresh 50% of status effect durations.

talents.name: Iron Grip
talents.description: +50% Weapon Handling.

talents.name: Kill Confirmed
talents.description: Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death. Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped and lasts 10s. Red Core - 5% Weapon Damage. Blue Core - 10% Bonus Armor. Yellow Core - 5% Skill Efficiency. For every trophy collected gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s. Maximum 30 stacks.

talents.name: Makeshift Repairs
talents.description: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s.

talents.name: On Point
talents.description: Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.  No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.  Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

talents.name: One in the Hand... / ...Two in the Bag
talents.description: Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 skill tier for 15s. Grants overcharge if already at skill tier 6. Cooldown: 60s. +1 Armor Kit Capacity. +3 Grenade Capacity. +25% Ammo Capacity. +10% Repair-Skills. +10% Status Effects.

talents.name: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
talents.description: The Incinerator Turret spins 360 degrees. You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret's fire. The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled.

talents.name: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype
talents.description: Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%. Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s.

talents.name: Ostracize
talents.description: Shooting an enemy applies a mark. Only one mark can be active at a time. The mark disappears after 15s, or when the marked enemy dies. Receive 600% Amplified Damage from the marked enemy. Deal 30% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies. If only one enemy remains in combat, the mark disappears and cannot be reapplied.

talents.name: Over the top
talents.description: Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack, activates Seeing Red. Seeing Red grants +25% total weapon damage and +100% melee damage. Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and starts a 60 second cooldown after completion. While in cooldown, damaging an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

talents.name: Pack Instincts
talents.description: You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit. 0-15m: +25% critical hit damage. 15-25m: +10% critical hit chance and +10% critical hit damage. 25m+: +25% critical hit chance.

allyEffects.name: Pack Instincts (0-15m)
allyEffects.description: While the giver's last hit enemy was within 15m. Tick only the band that matches.

allyEffects.name: Pack Instincts (15-25m)
allyEffects.description: While the giver's last hit enemy was 15-25m away. Tick only the band that matches.

allyEffects.name: Pack Instincts (25m+)
allyEffects.description: While the giver's last hit enemy was over 25m away. Tick only the band that matches.

talents.name: Parkour!
talents.description: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.description: While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 0.3s, up to 100. When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack. This deals headshot damage to anywhere you hit.

talents.name: Rebalance
talents.description: Getting kills and hitting enemies 3 times build Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage. Getting hit 3 times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance. Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

talents.name: Red, White and Blue
talents.description: Enemies you shoot receive stacking debuffs of Red/White/Blue. Changes every 2 seconds. Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%. White: Hitting the enemy restores you and your allies' armor by 2% once every second. Blue: Decreases enemy damage dealt by 10%. Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all three debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. Explosion strength is reduced on Named enemy deaths.

talents.name: Resourceful
talents.description: Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and/or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear and/or Brand Sets bonus. Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

talents.name: Return to Sender
talents.description: For PvE: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills. For PvP: Receive repairs of 5% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

talents.name: Rules of Engagement
talents.description: Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark. Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party. Mark lasts for 10 seconds. Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

talents.name: Slotted
talents.description: Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color: Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage. Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency. Blue: +1% Armor Regen. This item can feature any Core Attribute. This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot. This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health, or Skill Repair Attributes.

talents.name: Smoke Screen
talents.description: On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 3s. Cooldown: 40s.

talents.name: Stand Your Ground
talents.description: Cannot be staggered by explosions. Increases total weapon damage by 3% each second you are not moving. Stacks up to 10 until you start moving. All stacks lost 10s after moving.

talents.name: Stoic
talents.description: Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group.

talents.name: Striker's Gamble
talents.description: Weapon hits amplify total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times. 1 stack lost per second between 0 to 50 stacks; 2 stacks lost per second between 51 and 100 stacks.

talents.name: Symphony
talents.description: Kills Beyond 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +25% Bonus Armor for 15s. Kills Within 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Marksman Rifles and Rifles; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s. Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges builds up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered simultaneously for 15s. No stacks gained while talent is active.

talents.name: Tend and Befriend
talents.description: Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using / Deploying the Skill, Changing the skills target, Healing the skill.

talents.name: Throttle Control
talents.description: Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

talents.name: Toxic Delivery
talents.description: Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s. Total Damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

talents.name: Transference Overclock
talents.description: Grants 15% Hive skill haste per skill tier. Detonating a hive refreshes your skill cooldowns and grants overcharge for 15s. If at Skill Tier 6, this effect also applies to all allies. Allies receiving this effect are unable to benefit from it again for 120s.

talents.name: Vicious Cycle
talents.description: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

talents.name: Weakest Link
talents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

talents.name: Spontaneous Combustion
talents.description: Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy. If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn

talents.name: Flashpoint
talents.description: Increase the chance of applying Burn of Spontaneous Combustion to 60%

talents.name: White Hot
talents.description: Increase the Duration of the Burn Damage debuff of Spontaneous Combustion by +50%

talents.name: Resolved
talents.description: Your next body shot will be considered a headshot. Cooldown: 2s Requires Equipped: Marksman Rifle, Rifle or Pistol

talents.name: Decoy King
talents.description: While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases. Starting from a New Moon, weapon damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon return to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle. During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.

talents.name: Breadbasket
talents.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +55% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 3.

talents.name: Perfect Breadbasket
talents.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +70% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 2.

talents.name: Killer
talents.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +70% critical hit damage for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect Killer
talents.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +90% critical hit damage for 10s.

talents.name: Preservation
talents.description: Killing an enemy repairs 10% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 10%

talents.name: Perfect Preservation
talents.description: Killing an enemy repairs 15% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 15%

talents.name: Optimist
talents.description: Weapon damage is increased by +3.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

talents.name: Perfect Optimist
talents.description: Weapon damage is increased by +4.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

talents.name: Strained
talents.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Perfect Strained
talents.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 8 times.

talents.name: Close & Personal
talents.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect Close & Personal
talents.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +38% weapon damage for 10s.

talents.name: Fast Hands
talents.description: Critical hits add a stack of 3% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

talents.name: Perfect Fast Hands
talents.description: Critical hits add a stack of 5% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

talents.name: Sadist
talents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 4 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Sadist
talents.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 3 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Eyeless
talents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 4 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Eyeless
talents.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 3 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Ignited
talents.description: Amplifies +25% weapon damage to burning enemies.  After 4 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Ignited
talents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to burning enemies. After 3 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Vindictive
talents.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 15m 16% Critical hit chance and 16% critical hit damage for 20s.

allyEffects.name: Vindictive
allyEffects.description: For 20s after the giver kills an enemy with a status effect applied, for allies within 15m.

talents.name: Perfect Vindictive
talents.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 20m 21% Critical hit chance and 21% critical hit damage for 20s.

allyEffects.name: Perfect Vindictive
allyEffects.description: For 20s after the giver kills an enemy with a status effect applied, for allies within 20m.

talents.name: Ranger
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 4m you are away from your target.

talents.name: Perfect Ranger
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 3m you are away from your target.

talents.name: Steady Handed
talents.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 100 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

talents.name: Perfect Steady Handed
talents.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 75 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

talents.name: Spike
talents.description: Headshots grant +20% skill damage for 15s.

talents.name: Perfect Spike
talents.description: Headshots grant +25% skill damage for 15s.

talents.name: Perpetuation
talents.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 20s.

talents.name: Perfect Perpetuation
talents.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 16s.

talents.name: Reformation
talents.description: Headshots grant +60% skill repair for 15s.

talents.name: Perfect Reformation
talents.description: Headshots grant +80% skill repair for 15s.

talents.name: Future Perfect
talents.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

talents.name: Future Perfection
talents.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19s. Stacks up to 4 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

talents.name: Flatline
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to pulsed enemies. After 4 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Flatline
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to pulsed enemies. After 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Sledgehammer
talents.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 15% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -20% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

talents.name: Perfect Sledgehammer
talents.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 20% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -30% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

talents.name: Thunder Strike
talents.description: Amplifies 30% extra damage to shocked targets. After 4 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Thunder Strike
talents.description: Amplifies 35% extra damage to shocked targets. After 3 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: In Sync
talents.description: Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +15% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

talents.name: Perfect In Sync
talents.description: Hitting an enemy grants +20% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +20% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

talents.name: Pressure Point
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to enemies under status effects.

talents.name: Perfect Pressure Point
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to enemies under status effects.

talents.name: Streamline
talents.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 42% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

talents.name: Perfect Streamline
talents.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

talents.name: Immobilize
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to ensared enemies. After 4 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Immobilize
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensared enemies. After 3 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

talents.name: Soft Spot
talents.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 27% Weapon Damage for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect Soft Spot
talents.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 24% Weapon Damage for 15s.

talents.name: Rifleman
talents.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +10% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 5. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

talents.name: Perfect Rifleman
talents.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +11% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 6. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

talents.name: Boomerang
talents.description: Critical hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 40% increased damage.

talents.name: Perfect Boomerang
talents.description: Critical hits have a 75% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 50% increased damage.

talents.name: Lucky Shot
talents.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 20%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

talents.name: Perfect Lucky Shot
talents.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 30%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

talents.name: Determined
talents.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed headshot.

modifiers.value: practical_kills_per_shot * practical_headshot_fraction * (1 - practical_headshot_fraction) * max(0, (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) - max(0, equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage))

talents.name: Perfect Determined
talents.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed (critical) headshot.

modifiers.value: practical_kills_per_shot * practical_headshot_fraction * max(0, max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) - (practical_headshot_fraction * (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + (1 - practical_headshot_fraction) * max(0, equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage)))

talents.name: Behind You
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.

talents.name: Perfect Behind You
talents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

talents.name: Precision Strike
talents.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 3. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 20% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

talents.name: Perfect Precision Strike
talents.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 2. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 35% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

talents.name: Near Sighted
talents.description: Receive +80% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

talents.name: Perfect Near Sighted
talents.description: Receive +100% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

talents.name: On Empty
talents.description: Reloading from empty grants +60% weapon handling for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect On Empty
talents.description: Reloading from empty grants +80% weapon handling for 10s.

talents.name: Measured
talents.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -25% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +30% total weapon damage.

talents.name: Perfect Measured
talents.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +38% total weapon damage.

talents.name: Overflowing
talents.description: Every 3 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

talents.name: Perfect Overflowing
talents.description: Every 2 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

talents.name: Stabilize
talents.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 60%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 4 seconds.

talents.name: Perfect Stabilize
talents.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 75%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 6 seconds.

talents.name: Naked
talents.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 5s.

talents.name: Perfect Naked
talents.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 8s.

talents.name: First Blood
talents.description: If scoped, your first shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

modifiers.value: practical_hit_fraction * (1 - practical_headshot_fraction) * max(0, (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) - max(0, equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage))

talents.name: Perfect First Blood
talents.description: If scoped, your first 2 shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

modifiers.value: 2 * practical_hit_fraction * (1 - practical_headshot_fraction) * max(0, (max(0, equipped_weapon_headshot_damage) * (1 - max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) + max(0, equipped_weapon_critical_headshot_damage) * max(0, min(1, effective_critical_hit_chance))) - max(0, equipped_weapon_average_bodyshot_damage))

talents.name: Outsider
talents.description: After killing an enemy, gain 100% optimal range and +100% accuracy for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect Outsider
talents.description: After killing an enemy, gain 150% optimal range and +125% accuracy for 10s.

talents.name: Unwavering
talents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +300% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

talents.name: Perfect Unwavering
talents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +400% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

talents.name: Unhinged
talents.description: Grants +18% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

talents.name: Perfect Unhinged
talents.description: Grants +22% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.description: For every 10 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

talents.name: Perfect Frenzy
talents.description: For every 8 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

talents.name: Overwhelm
talents.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +10% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

talents.name: Perfect Overwhelm
talents.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +12% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

talents.name: Pummel
talents.description: 3 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

talents.name: Perfect Pummel
talents.description: 2 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

talents.name: Pumped Up
talents.description: Reloading grants +1.2% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 25 times.

talents.name: Perfect Pumped Up
talents.description: Reloading grants +6% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Brazen
talents.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 6 pellets hit.

talents.name: Perfect Brazen
talents.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.

talents.name: Salvage
talents.description: Killing a target has a +70% chance to refill the magazine.

talents.name: Perfect Salvage
talents.description: Killing a target has a +85% chance to refill the magazine.

talents.name: Finisher
talents.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 30% critical hit chance and 30% critical hit damage for 15s.

talents.name: Perfect Finisher
talents.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 35% critical hit chance and 40% critical hit damage for 15s.

talents.name: Back and Forth
talents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +10% Rate of Fire and +9% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

talents.name: Perfect Back and Forth
talents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

talents.name: Head Scratcher
talents.description: Deal 30% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Head Scratcher
talents.description: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 3 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

talents.name: Perfect Allegro
talents.description: 15% rate of fire.

talents.name: Perfect Accurate
talents.description: 80% accuracy.

talents.name: Perfect Extra
talents.description: +30% magazine capacity.

talents.name: Perfect Distance
talents.description: +25% optimal range.

talents.name: Perfect Jazz Hands
talents.description: 50% reload speed.

talents.name: Perfect Optimized
talents.description: 20% weapon handling.

talents.name: Actum Est
talents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. At 100 stacks the next magazine will be 100% filled with shock ammo.

talents.name: Adaptive Instincts
talents.description: Hitting 30 headshots grants 20% critical hit chance and 50% critical hit damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 65 body shots grants 90% weapon damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 20 leg shots grants 150% reload speed for 45 seconds. Buffs refresh when out of combat.

talents.name: Agonizing Bite
talents.description: Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you. Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5 seconds. A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

talents.name: Ardent
talents.description: Shooting heats up the weapon, filling up heat meter. The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's standard Magazine Size. When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon will ignite enemies. When not shooting, the meter depletes over time. Reloading or swapping the weapon fully depletes the meter.

talents.name: Autentico
talents.description: +35 Weapon Damage. +100% accuracy. No Damage Drop Off. These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

talents.name: Big Game Hunter
talents.description: When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot. Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times. Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

talents.name: Binary Trigger
talents.description: This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack. At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals 500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

talents.name: Blossom Harvest
talents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 3.3% for each 10% combined Armor and Health the enemy has remaining.

talents.name: Breathe Free
talents.description: When moving, gain 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 75%. Kills grant +20% movement speed for 10s.

talents.name: Bullet Hell
talents.description: This weapon never needs to be reloaded. For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and all your allies' reserves.

talents.name: Busy Little Bee
talents.description: Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% amplified weapon damage increase. Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapon and will last for 10 seconds.

talents.name: Caduceus
talents.description: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

talents.name: Capacitance
talents.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second. For each skill tier gain 7.5% Weapon Damage.

talents.name: Capitulate
talents.description: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.

talents.name: Shakedown
talents.description: Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks. This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack. Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack. Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplified Damage from you for 5s

talents.name: Cover Shooter
talents.description: Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

talents.name: Disruptor Rounds
talents.description: Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent. When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect. 1-10 Stacks: Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds. 11-25 Stacks: Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds. 26-49 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds. 50 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

talents.name: Doctor Home
talents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will apply a mark for 5 seconds. If a marked target is killed it will give a 50% armor repair kit which applies to the whole party. The kit will not give bonus armor.

talents.name: Eagle's Strike / Tenacity
talents.description: Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to 30%. Headshot kills grant the Tenacity buff for 15 seconds. The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots. Tenacity: 40-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires. All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100%.

talents.name: Electromagnetic Accelerator
talents.description: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

talents.name: Faster Than Reloading
talents.description: Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied. Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

talents.name: Full Stop
talents.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20. Headshots grant 2 stacks. Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed. Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

talents.name: Gangland Hit
talents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark. More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4. This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own

talents.name: Geri and Freki
talents.description: On trigger pull, fire both barrels at once. When fired from the right shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder. Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present. When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates for 5s. Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

talents.name: Hidden Rock
talents.description: Headshots apply confuse. Cooldown 20s.

talents.name: High Priority Target
talents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

talents.name: In Plain Sight
talents.description: Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you. Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you is amplified by 65%. Headshot kills reset the cooldown of your Decoy Skill. This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

talents.name: Incessant Chatter
talents.description: When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 25% for each enemy within 15m for the duration of that magazine. Max stacks: 5. Kills refill 50% of your magazine.

talents.name: Liberty or Death
talents.description: Hits grant +2% weapon damage. Stacks up to 30 times. Headshots consume all stacks, repairing your shield for 3% per stack.

talents.name: Mosquito Song
talents.description: Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players. At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor. Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

talents.name: Ortiz Assault Interface
talents.description: While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy. The weapon amplifies damage by +60% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

talents.name: Pakhan
talents.description: Each kill with this weapon gains a stack of 75% Base Magazine Size increase to the next magazine, up to 4 stacks.

talents.name: Payment in Kind
talents.description: Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of 2% Critical Hit Damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s. On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

talents.name: Perturb
talents.description: While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will Prime it. While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when Shooting for 20s. Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

talents.name: Plague of the Outcasts
talents.description: Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. This stacks up to 50 times. Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, the stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

talents.name: Primer Rounds
talents.description: Damaged enemies lose 50% burn resistance for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Regicide
talents.description: Headshot Kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

talents.name: Restrained
talents.description: The pistol is fully automatic and deals +25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken.

talents.name: Rule Them All
talents.description: When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, 50% of the ammo in their next magazine will apply the same Status Effect to their targets. This effect will only occur during combat.

talents.name: Sandman
talents.description: Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies. Cooldown: 15s.

talents.name: Septic Shock
talents.description: Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks add more severe debuffs to the target. 2 - Poison. 4 - Disorient. 6 - Shock. 9 - Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources). Stacks no longer increase. Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

talents.name: Sport Mode
talents.description: +20% Movement Speed. This bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses.

talents.name: Swift
talents.description: Performing a cover to cover grants +20% weapon damage for 20s.

talents.name: Symbiosis
talents.description: While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second. Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

talents.name: The Trap
talents.description: Tags enemies when in scope (maximum 10). If Agent kills any marked target with a headshot, all other targets will have 50% (20% PVP) movement speed and receive burn for 10 seconds. Cooldown 30 seconds. Killing another enemy with a headshot will shorten the cooldown for 10 seconds. Targets are marked after 1 second in crosshair.

talents.name: Transfusion
talents.description: Hitting headshots builds stacks up to a max of 8. When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the shot damage for each stack. Healed Allies receive 200% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10 seconds. All hits become guaranteed headshots for 8 seconds after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

talents.name: Unnerve
talents.description: Killing an enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5. All marks on an enemy will disappear 10s after the last one has been applied. Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

talents.name: You can look...but you can't touch
talents.description: When out of combat, receive 10 stacks. This weapon deals +11% Amplified Damage per stack. 1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s.

talents.name: Boiling Point
talents.description: The first 53% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

talents.name: Perfect Boiling Point
talents.description: The first 48% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

talents.name: Dragon's Breath
talents.description: This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn to the enemy. An enemy cannot be applied Burn if they are burning already. Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.

talents.name: Foam at the Mouth
talents.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot, applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit. Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensnared enemies.

talents.name: Refreshing
talents.description: The weapon fires a stream of water. Hitting an ally agent builds stacks on them. Max stack is 5. Stacks deplete every 2s. While having at least 1 stack, the ally will have +50% Hazard Protection.

allyEffects.name: Refreshing
allyEffects.description: While the ally has at least one stack from the giver's Cooler stream.

talents.name: Startling
talents.description: Whenever this weapon makes an enemy Suppressed, the enemy is applied Disorient, and you and allies receive +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s.

allyEffects.name: Startling
allyEffects.description: For 15s after the giver's weapon suppresses an enemy.
